parameters.name: MaxItem
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token for the next query to return more results.
> You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. If a query does not return all results, pass the **NextToken** value returned from the previous query to continue the query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID. Valid values:
- Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com): cn-hangzhou
- Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com): ap-southeast-1.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. Enter a site ID or a DNS record ID. You must specify at least one of ResourceId and Tag.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

- site: site
- record: DNS record.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags. You must specify at least one of ResourceId and Tag.
